title: Mathematics for Data Science I
standfirst: Sets, functions, straight lines, matrices, permutations, and a first taste of calculus — the mathematical vocabulary every later course will assume you already speak.
instructor: Prof. Neelesh Upadhye, Prof. Madhavan Mukund & Prof. Sarang S Sane

description_paragraphs: This course introduces functions - including Linear, Quadratic, Polynomial, Exponential, and Logarithmic - along with Single-Variable Calculus and foundational Discrete Mathematics, including Graph Theory, through numerous examples. This course shall develop the ability to model real-world situations using abstract mathematical structures.
faculty: Prof. Neelesh Upadhye, Department of Mathematics, IIT Madras
Prof. Madhavan Mukund, Director, Chennai Mathematical Institute
Prof. Sarang S Sane, Department of Mathematics, IIT Madras

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Set theory - number systems, sets and their operations; Relations & functions and their types.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Rectangular coordinate system, straight lines - slope, parallel and perpendicular lines, representations, general equations, and straight-line fitting.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Quadratic functions - properties, minima, maxima, vertex, and slope; Quadratic Equations.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Polynomial algebra - basic arithmetic operations and algorithms; Polynomial graphs - x-intercepts, multiplicities, end behavior, and turning points; Graphing and polynomial construction.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Functions - horizontal and vertical line tests; Exponential, composite, and inverse functions.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: Logarithmic functions - properties, graphs; Exponential and logarithmic equations.

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Sequence and limits; Function of one variable - graphs and tangents; Limits for sequences and functions; Continuity.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Derivatives and critical points - differentiability; Computing derivatives and L'Hôpital's rule - tangents and linear approximation; Local maxima and minima.

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: Integrals of functions of one variable - computing areas (including area under a curve); Relationship between derivatives and integrals.

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Graph theory - graph representation; Breadth-first search, Depth-first search and their applications; Directed acyclic graphs; Complexity analysis; Topological sorting.

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: Graph Algorithms - longest path, transitive closure, matrix multiplication; Shortest paths (single source and all-pairs); Dijkstra's, Bellman-Ford, and Floyd-Warshall algorithm; Minimum cost spanning trees; Prim's and Kruskal's algorithm
